Bit reversal: the order an FFT reads its input in

Pick a size and an index: its bits read backwards give the place it takes at the input of a radix-2 FFT. See the whole crossing pattern at once.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/dsp/signals.t27 (t27#8985): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • J. W. Cooley, J. W. Tukey, An algorithm for the machine calculation of complex Fourier series, Math. Comp. 19, 1965
  • R. G. Lyons, Understanding Digital Signal Processing, 3rd ed., ch. 4: the radix-2 FFT and bit reversal
